scripture.verse: "I will greatly rejoice in the Lord; my soul will exalt my God. He has clothed me in a garment of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness."

quote.verse: "Become pure in heart. The pure heart shall see God."
quote.author: Henry Drummond

scripture.verse: "Pure and genuine religion in the sight of God the Father means caring for widows and orphans ...and refusing to let the world corrupt you."

quote.verse: "When saints cease to seek holiness, purity, righteousness, truth ...then it is that Satan comes."
quote.author: Smith Wigglesworth

scripture.verse: "Be at peace with everyone, and work out living a holy life; those who are not holy will not see the Lord."

quote.verse: "The proof of spiritual maturity is not how pure you are, but an awareness of your impurity."
quote.author: Philip Brooks

scripture.verse: "Do everything without grumbling or arguing, so that you may become blameless and pure children of God."

quote.verse: "Pure morality points you to the purest one of all - Jesus, Son of God."
quote.author: Ravi Zacharias

scripture.verse: "For the love of money is the root of all evil. But you pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness."

quote.verse: "God has guarded His Word so that only the pure in heart can see its secrets."
quote.author: Winkie Pratney

scripture.verse: "To the pure, all things are pure but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure."

quote.verse: "He that loves the Word and the purity of its precepts cannot turn traitor."
quote.author: William Gurnell

scripture.verse: "I will set nothing wicked before my eyes."

quote.verse: "O Lord keep our heart, keep our eyes, keep our feet, keep our tongues."
quote.author: William Tiptaft

scripture.verse: "Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin."

quote.verse: "This desire for a heart of purity is a creation of the Holy Spirit at work in the heart."
quote.author: Duncan Campbell
